_about: Every raw take the reels cut from: what it shows, how it is recorded, its named moments (marks). source: launcher-fake = takes.cjs, the launcher's own pages with the test core (anywhere with node and Playwright: the cloud or the PC); launcher / game = record.py on the owner's PC (the real launcher and game, ffmpeg gdigrab); site / phone = record.py on the PC (Edge driven over its debugging port, the live website), or takes.cjs from the site's own pages offline (offline: true); hand = record.py --hand: a box says what to do, the screen is recorded for `seconds` (Control step reel-record-hand). Nothing here types a password or makes an account.

lf-login.what: The launcher opens on Log in; a Hero Key pasted; the signed-in moment; Home.

lf-play-official.what: The realm picker, Wrath Unleashed, PLAY: it starts and logs you in by itself.

lf-switch.what: Realms: Community, Frost Haven, PLAY; then back to Wrath Unleashed and PLAY again, nothing to change by hand.

lf-single.what: Single player from the side menu: the three steps and Start.

lf-mods-hd.what: Mods & Addons, Discover: the HD pack (credited to Project Reforged), Install.

lf-den-open.what: The realm picker: Your Den; its page; Play.

lf-host.what: Host: a template, a name, Start; You're live; the new realm in the Community list.

lf-add-folder.what: Find your game files: a folder picked, the launcher reads its version and names it; PLAY.

site-home.what: leylinelauncher.com from the top, a slow scroll.

site-live.what: The live leylinelauncher.com in Edge on this PC (a fresh profile, nothing logged in), scrolled with the keyboard.

site-queue.what: The browser game's line: your place and the wait (never the seat numbers), then Skip the line.

phone-play.what: The website on a phone: Start here, then Play in your browser.

game-official-world.what: The real game from PLAY on Wrath Unleashed (Leyline.exe play-test --official --world): it logs in by itself, character select, into the world.

game-den-open.what: Your Den from the launcher (Leyline.exe den-play --test): Den Lite and the game start, logged in by itself, in the Den.

game-den-carry.what: In the Den: build mode, a piece placed from the gallery, picked up and carried, set down, turned (the Leyline UI's own buttons through its test actions).

game-den-fly.what: In the Den: the free flight (W held), snap out to the whole Den, zoom far out and back.

hand-community.prompt: In the launcher: pick a community realm (Realms > Community), press PLAY, let it log in, then close the game; pick Wrath Unleashed again and PLAY. The whole screen is recorded.
hand-community.what: The real switch from a community realm back to the official one, in the game.

hand-single-bots.prompt: Single player: press Start on the Single player page, enter the world, open the Bots window (the bar's Bots button), add a companion and a dungeon buddy.
hand-single-bots.what: Single player from Start to companions at your side.

hand-hd-before.prompt: HD pack OFF: stand somewhere pretty (Dalaran's fountain works), camera still, recording for 12 s.
hand-hd-before.what: The before shot of the HD before/after.

hand-hd-after.prompt: HD pack ON (Mods & Addons, Project Reforged): the same spot and camera as the before shot, recording for 12 s.
hand-hd-after.what: The after shot of the HD before/after.

hand-launcher.prompt: Open the Leyline launcher (logged in). When recording starts: Home, then Realms (Official, Community), then Mods & Addons, slowly.
hand-launcher.what: The real launcher window, a calm tour of its pages.
